description: Header file defining network I/O functions and error handling for the lighttpd project, including read/write wrappers and platform-specific sendfile support.

methods.name: li_network_error_quark
methods.description: Returns a GQuark identifying network error domain.

methods.name: li_net_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation, repeating after EINTR.

methods.name: li_net_read
methods.description: Performs a read operation, repeating after EINTR.

methods.name: li_network_write
methods.description: Sends data from a chunk queue over a socket.

methods.name: li_network_read
methods.description: Reads data into a chunk queue from a socket.

methods.name: li_network_write_writev
methods.description: Writes data using writv or buffered methods.

methods.name: li_network_write_sendfile
methods.description: Uses sendfile system call for file transmission, if supported.

methods.name: li_network_backend_write
methods.description: Backend method for writing data, similar to li_network_write.

methods.name: LI_NETWORK_FALLBACK
methods.description: Macro to attempt a network operation and fallback on failure.
